context: Yuki has come to Saito's clinic for a routine annual check. The encounter is professional but warm — Saito is also a friend of a friend.
purpose: small medical encounter — professional with a small human note

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 田中さん、こんにちは。お変わりないですか？
lines.style: Calm professional. Sits across from her.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: はい…たぶん。少し、最近、疲れやすくて。
lines.en: Yes… probably. Just — tired easily lately.
lines.style: A small honest report. Voice careful.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: なるほど。…どのくらい前から？
lines.style: Plain professional follow-up — with steady attentive presence.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.style: A small honest admission. Voice slightly lower.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 本当に？それは、ちゃんと診ましょう。
lines.style: A small note of real concern professionally framed.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 心配かけて、すみません。
lines.style: A reflexive apology. Half-bow — no rush in the delivery.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 心配は仕事ですから。…体重、少し測りますね。
lines.en: Worrying is my job. …Let's check your weight.
lines.style: A small warm joke that lands.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: はい。…本当にありがとうございます。
lines.style: A small grateful exhale — voice carries the moment fully.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 大丈夫ですよ。時間、ゆっくり取りますから。
lines.en: It'll be fine. I'll take my time, properly.
lines.style: A small steady kindness. Closes the loop.
